title: quercus pubescens var. lanuginosa
intro: Quercus pubescens var. lanuginosa, commonly known as Downy White Oak, is a deciduous shrub or small tree with downy leaves and white, warty bark. The plant is valued for its health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. It is used for its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, antiseptic, and anti-arthritic effects. The bioactive constituents of Downy White Oak include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
